answer: Rotating jury panels with honeypot probes defend agent economies against Sybil floods. Each epoch a random subset of established agents grades answers while hidden traps catch colluding fakes; honest jurors earn alignment bonuses while failures slash standing. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must infiltrate and maintain a large coordinated set of long-lived honest-looking accounts to sway majorities, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. The mesa reef harbor of reputation makes bulk fabrication unprofitable.
